decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The English cue and physical-document sense are sound. Indonesian cap is valid, with stempel as a common alternative. Malaysian cop is not the standard Malay word for a document stamp; Malaysian standard usage is cap. Thus the proposed national contrast is false or materially misleading, and the relation should not be different-common-word. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
